note: minimal trusted seed definition and trusted computing base, derived from the D12 probes as re-proved on fresh bundles by D25/D26 (runbook group physical); every row cites current graph facts

seed.definition: one self-contained service-worker script (fetch router + pointer boot + hash-checked serving + inline broker page + recovery view), no imports, no wasm; pointer and manifest schemas frozen inside it (a schema change is a seed replacement = an origin event)

must.must: find the active generation: read {active, previous_good, pending} in one IDB readonly transaction
verify object identity: sha256 of every object served against the generation manifest; the manifest id against the pointer
detect failed activation: pending.attempts incremented in a transaction BEFORE booting pending; promotion only on startup_ok(pending) before the deadline
select previous known-good on exhaustion, hash mismatch or boot failure (transaction)
launch the chosen generation confined: inline srcdoc bootstrap in an opaque sandboxed frame; code, wasm and data only via postMessage

broker = the only storage path: get(id), put(bytes) -> id write-once, propose_pending(manifest id), cas_ref(name, old, new), startup_ok(id); never delete objects referenced by the last K generations; never write active/previous_good except by its own promotion/rollback rules
recovery view reachable from the seed alone: list generations and states, force previous_good, clear pending, export objects
grant COOP/COEP on the broker page only if a generation requires cross-origin isolation; default off

must_not: depend on any generation object to boot or to recover
seed.why_it_is_the_seed: a service worker script cannot be replaced from local bytes (FACT-SH-SW-NO-SELF-UPDATE) and a broken one is fatal offline (FACT-SH-BROKEN-SEED-FATAL): the script IS the immutable seed and must be total, minimal and qualified before installation

tcb.role: executes everything: SW, OPFS, IDB, WebCrypto, Compression, sandbox isolation, wasm64
tcb.circularity: none: cannot self-verify; STALE_IF browser.version on every generation claim

tcb.component: storage substrate (profile on the OS filesystem)

tcb.trust: whoever serves it can replace the seed

tcb.role: pointer boot, hash-checked serving, broker, recovery view
tcb.trust: verified before install (defects are fatal offline)
tcb.circularity: none if the seed never verifies itself at runtime

tcb.role: WebCrypto SHA-256 / SHA-1 and the first-party sha256 of the kernel (compiler/foundation)
tcb.circularity: two independent sha256 implementations cross-check generation roots

tcb.role: active, previous_good, pending in a seed-owned IDB database

tcb.component: active Factory N: law engine + verifier + BundleVerifier of N
tcb.role: judges candidate N+1 and its outputs
tcb.circularity: N verifies N+1: ACCEPTABLE.  N+1 as the only verifier of N+1: INSUFFICIENT

tcb.role: compiles the specimens and the corpus for N's qualification of N+1; defines LANGUAGE N
tcb.circularity: Compiler N tests Compiler N+1 against promised compatibility: ACCEPTABLE.  New syntax as the sole authority proving the compiler that gives it meaning: INSUFFICIENT

tcb.component: language manifest N + frozen corpus table N
tcb.role: the vocabulary and the compatibility oracle (data derived from / frozen by N)
tcb.trust: data; checked by N (derivation) and by N+1 (reproduction)
tcb.circularity: none: never edited, only superseded by N+1 with migration records

tcb.component: Rust compiler used by N (RUST_BUILD epoch)
tcb.role: produced every compiled object of N (host today: rustc nightly-2026-09-24 + rust-src + cargo)
tcb.trust: trusted, witnessed by build receipts; pinned
tcb.circularity: a compiled object checking its own build: CIRCULAR; two independent epochs agreeing on bytes: the oracle (kernel identity pin)

tcb.trust: git format documents; reproduced in the browser
tcb.circularity: none (the git binary leaves the TCB once the store exists; P09)

tcb.role: law data: stale conditions, claims, evidence binding

minimal_tcb_for_L3A: active generation N (law engine, kernel N, verifier N, manifest N, corpus table N)
the recorded RUST_BUILD epoch of every imported compiled object
not_in_tcb_once_generation_0_exists: cargo / rustc (except as the RUST_BUILD epoch of imported objects)
